guides.title: 架構、算例與證據：Alps Grace–Hopper 超級電腦
guides.titleEn: Architecture, examples and evidence: Alps Grace-Hopper supercomputer
guides.concept: 以異質節點分區及 CPU–GPU 相干互連解析Alps Grace–Hopper 超級電腦：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
guides.conceptEn: Explore Alps Grace-Hopper supercomputer through heterogeneous partitions and coherent cpu-gpu links: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
procedure: 在「Alps Grace–Hopper 超級電腦」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識GH200相干記憶。CPU、加速器及NUMA位置決定延遲與搬運；共享地址不意味着等距存取。 建立節點與記憶體層級的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是異質節點分區及 CPU–GPU 相干互連。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。畫節點拓撲並比較本地與遠端假想訪存。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

在「Alps Grace–Hopper 超級電腦」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識node內與Slingshot。高速內連與外部網絡有不同路由、端點與割頻寬；性能需分層。 建立節點內與節點間網路的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是異質節點分區及 CPU–GPU 相干互連。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。按perlink、pernode及system標註雙向頻寬。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

在「Alps Grace–Hopper 超級電腦」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識異質partition選擇。串行部分、負載不均與通信限制擴充；峯值FLOPS不是應用耗時。 建立工作分割與平行效率的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是異質節點分區及 CPU–GPU 相干互連。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。對固定工作量重算Amdahl上限和通信餘量。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。

在「Alps Grace–Hopper 超級電腦」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識scratch與archive。暫存、容量與歸檔層服務不同I/O；檢查點需考慮寫入和恢復成本。 建立儲存階層與檢查點的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是異質節點分區及 CPU–GPU 相干互連。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較順序、隨機及metadata的假想時間預算。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Alps Grace–Hopper 超級電腦」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識機櫃冷卻預算。設施功率包含IT與輔助；PUE不能單獨判定計算結果每單位能耗。 建立供電冷卻與設施的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是異質節點分區及 CPU–GPU 相干互連。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。覈對IT、總設施及作業時間的能量邊界。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
在「Alps Grace–Hopper 超級電腦」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識分區作業復原。多租戶作業需資源限制與可恢復狀態；硬體可用不等於應用已恢復。 建立排程隔離與復原的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是異質節點分區及 CPU–GPU 相干互連。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。在離線事件表追蹤節點失效、重排與結果一致性。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
procedureEn: Identify gh200 coherent memory in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Alps Grace-Hopper supercomputer. CPUs, accelerators and NUMA placement determine latency/traffic; shared addresses do not imply uniform access. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of nodes and memory hierarchy, focusing on heterogeneous partitions and coherent cpu-gpu links. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Draw node topology and compare local/remote assumed access. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify intranode and slingshot in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Alps Grace-Hopper supercomputer. Internal/external fabrics differ in routes, endpoints and bisection; evaluate by layer. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of intranode and internode networks, focusing on heterogeneous partitions and coherent cpu-gpu links. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Label bidirectional per-link, per-node and system bandwidth. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify heterogeneous partition choice in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Alps Grace-Hopper supercomputer. Serial work, imbalance and communication limit scaling; peak FLOPS are not application time. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of work partition and parallel efficiency, focusing on heterogeneous partitions and coherent cpu-gpu links. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Recalculate Amdahl bounds/communication margins for fixed work. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify scratch and archive in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Alps Grace-Hopper supercomputer. Scratch, capacity and archive serve different I/O; checkpoints need write/recovery costs. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of storage tiers and checkpoints, focusing on heterogeneous partitions and coherent cpu-gpu links. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare assumed sequential, random and metadata time budgets. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify cabinet cooling budget in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Alps Grace-Hopper supercomputer. Facility power includes IT/auxiliary loads; PUE alone does not specify energy per result. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of power, cooling and facilities, focusing on heterogeneous partitions and coherent cpu-gpu links. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Check IT, facility and job-time energy boundaries. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.

Identify partition job recovery in the mentor diagram and primary sources for Alps Grace-Hopper supercomputer. Multi-tenant jobs need limits/recoverable state; hardware availability is not application recovery. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of scheduling, isolation and recovery, focusing on heterogeneous partitions and coherent cpu-gpu links. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Trace failures, rescheduling and result consistency in an offline event table. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
evidence: 提交機櫃冷卻預算的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
提交分區作業復原的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
提交分區作業復原的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
evidenceEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for cabinet cooling budget.
Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for partition job recovery.

pitfalls: 常見誤判：換一臺節點就無需校驗恢復後的狀態。
pitfallsEn: Common misconception: Replacing a node requires no recovered-state validation.
